data.name: Marla
data.long_meaning: Marla is derived from the Latin word 'Marlis' which means 'little one' or 'rebel'. This name is a combination of the words 'Mara' meaning 'bitter' and 'Lael' meaning 'lion'. The name Marla represents a gentle yet strong and rebellious spirit.
